articles.title: Robinhood CEO says companies shouldn't get veto over stock tokens in AMC feud
articles.snippet: In a post on Friday, Vlad Tenev said securities issuers should control shareholder rights, but not separate products that track their publicly traded shares.

articles.title: OKX brings OpenAI and Anthropic bets to Europe as pre-IPO trading grows
articles.snippet: The exchange is offering up to 10x leverage on private-company valuations alongside 100 tokenized stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: North Korea using foreign talent to help infiltrate US companies: Report
articles.snippet: The DPRK has turned to third-country IT workers to pass job interviews, after which, the positions are usually taken over by North Korean operatives.

articles.title: Nvidia considers $10B investment in potential record Anthropic IPO: Reuters
articles.snippet: Anthropic is said to be seeking to raise as much as $100 billion in the offering, which could value the AI company at about $2 trillion.

articles.title: Hyperliquid’s biggest risk is regulation, says Ran Neuner
articles.snippet: The Crypto Banter founder said Hyperliquid’s network effects give it a strong competitive moat, but regulatory uncertainty remains its biggest threat.
